rows.en: Kasumi: "Oh, Touya-chan. What's wrong?"
Touya: "There's something I want to ask. Have you got a minute?"
Kasumi: "Yes. Oh, come in."
Kasumi: "What did you want to ask?"
Touya: "Well, I remembered something from a long time ago..."
Kasumi: "A long time ago?"
Touya: "...Second grade. Do you remember?"
Kasumi: "Oh... O-Of course.
That's when I met you, Touya-chan."
Touya: "Right. About back then..."
Why did you talk to someone like me?
Come to think of it, you wore glasses back then too, right?
Kasumi: "Huh?"
Touya: "Think about it. I was cut off from everyone else
in class. You could easily have ended up
the same way."
Kasumi: "...Hey, Touya-chan."
Touya: "Hmm?"
Kasumi: "When do you think I first met you, Touya-chan?"
Touya: "When? When you came and talked to me, right?"
Kasumi: "No. That wasn't the first time."
Touya: "O-Oh, right. We were in the same class.
My first day after transferring..."
Kasumi: "(Shakes her head.)"
Touya: "Huh?"
Kasumi: "The day before that."
Touya: "The day before...? Let's see, that would've been... Oh."
Kasumi: "The day you moved in, Touya-chan.
I saw you from the second-floor balcony.
But when I went downstairs, you were already inside, Touya-chan,
and then your mother noticed me...
That was the first time."
Touya: "How was I supposed to know that?
Besides, I barely remember moving in."
Kasumi: "I remember it clearly.
And what your mother said to me that day."
Touya: "What she said?"
Kasumi: "Yes. She asked me to be friends with you, Touya-chan..."
Yamato: "Is that why you spoke to Touya?"
Kasumi: "Yes. I'd meant to do it much sooner,
but I couldn't find the courage..."
Touya: "But back then, you said you couldn't just leave me alone..."
Kasumi: "Would the truth have made you happy, Touya-chan?"
Touya: "Hmm... I might've avoided you even more."
Kasumi: "See?"
Yamato: "You made a good call."
Kasumi: "But that wasn't the only reason I spoke to you.
Even if your mother hadn't asked, I think I'd have done the same thing.
It just would've happened sooner or later."
Touya: "So that's how it was...
Maybe that's part of what made me who I am now."
Kasumi: "Oh, you're exaggerating."
Touya: "But back then, after what happened at the airport,
you stayed with me the whole time..."
Kasumi: "Yes... Because back then, Touya-chan,
I felt like you'd disappear if I didn't hold
on to you..."
Touya: "You, your father, your mother, and Yamato.
I got back on my feet because you were all there..."
Kasumi: "I'm glad you feel that way.
Oh, right. Sisk gave me some cake.
Would you like to share it?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah. Sure.
I'll have some, then."
Kasumi: "Wait just a moment. I'll make tea too."
Yamato: "...Kasumi's such a good person."
Touya: "Yeah. She always has been."
Then we spent some time together,
talking about the old days...
Kasumi: "Huh? Yes... Since I started elementary school, I think."
Touya: "Huh... From too much reading or studying, I guess?"
Kasumi: "Hmm. I did like reading books, but...
my poor eyesight seems to run in the family."
Touya: "Now that you mention it, your mother's eyes were pretty bad too."
Kasumi: "Yes. It seems to be hereditary.
But once it reached a certain point, it stopped getting worse."
Touya: "How bad is it now?"
Kasumi: "0.01 or less."
Touya: "Hey, doesn't that mean...?"
Kasumi: "You can't measure it without a machine.
Even if I stand right at the front, I can't make out
the biggest symbol at the top."
Touya: "You shouldn't be saying that with a smile.
That's really bad."
Kasumi: "So if I take off my glasses..."
Kasumi: "I can't see unless I get this close."
Touya: "!! I-I see..."
Kasumi: "? What's wrong?"
Touya: "Nothing..."
Kasumi: "You're strange, Touya-chan."
Kasumi: "Oh, right. Sisk gave me some cake.
Would you like to share it?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah. Sure.
I'll have some, then."
Kasumi: "Wait just a moment. I'll make tea too."
Yamato: "What's wrong? Your face is looking a little red."
Touya: "...Shut up."
Then we spent some time together,
talking about the old days...
